Hi Emma —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us last week. We finished the initial latency/throughput pass and have a short set of summaries we think will be most useful for your SRE and procurement teams. I attached a single-file CSV with the raw traces and a one-page note.

High-level ask: can we schedule a 90–120 minute readout next week to walk through the results, answer engineering questions, and confirm the recommended config for your production rollout? Proposed agenda:
- 15m intro + success criteria recap
- 45m results deep-dive (latency p50/p95/p99, token-level breakdowns, seq len profiles)
- 20m ops/architecture Q&A (KV cache, batching knobs)
- 20–40m procurement/security sync (SLA, data residency, audit logs)

Available windows (PST):
- Tue 12/14: 09:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:30
- Wed 12/15: 10:30–13:00

If those don't work, tell us a few times that do and we'll triangulate with Marissa and Priyom. I've attached the CSV for pre-read (redwood-benchmark-summary-20271213.csv).

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher

If EdgeScale prefers the live replay (recommended for network jitter visibility), tell us and we'll reserve 120 minutes.

- 11:00–11:15 PT: Procurement quick sync (Sean leads)
